title: Whether ZPA changes need an activation step

prose.text: ZIA saves changes until they are activated; whether ZPA has an equivalent step is not stated by any source. See [[zia.api.activation]] for the ZIA model.

prose.label: Open.
prose.text: The earlier statement that ZPA writes take effect immediately is unverified {{gap:write-takes-effect}}.

checks.do: Before telling an operator no activation is needed, whether a tenant test confirms a ZPA write is live without any further call.

write-takes-effect.title: Whether a ZPA write is live without an activation call
write-takes-effect.detail: Unverified legacy statement: ZPA config changes take effect on write, with no equivalent of ZIA's activation. The Terraform ZPA provider has no activation resource and the ZPA OpenAPI document has no activation operation, but neither is a statement that none exists.
write-takes-effect.blocks: advising that a ZPA change is live immediately
